title: Great tour for a day trip from Seville.
text:
Very good day trip to get away from Seville and back to nature. We got to see lots of wildlife, as well as a variety of interesting landscapes including wetlands, woodland and sand dunes. The old town of El Rocio was also intersting. The tour guide Sergio was very friendly and informative.
Overall, a highly recommended tour.
author: kevgreentravels

title: La Donana in Fall
text: We were there in November. Saw a lot of Flamingos & storks. We were not allowed out of the vehicle at the park so small birds were harder to spot. Overall great, specially El Rocio town. A Spanish Western Town, great from a Texan point of view.
author: Changemyprofile

title: Amazing Trip! It rained the day we...
text:
Amazing Trip! It rained the day we went so made the experience more exciting.
You could smell Pine trees and Eucalyptus everywhere, it was so peaceful. The beach was really nice, shame we couldn't enjoy it because it rained. We didn't see the Iberia lynx due to the weather. I do the think price is quite heavy, but it's one of the few we found available so not much you can do with that. The tour guide was great too.
author: Saima V

title: Very much enjoyed the National Park...
text:
Very much enjoyed the National Park part of the tour. We drove in the large 4-wheel drive vehicle along the beach first. There were wild pigs and lots of interesting birds. We than visited some fishermen's houses and went into the woods. We saw some deer and wild pigs again. Then we drove through some interesting large sand dunes surrounding and covering up pine trees, while the guide explained how the dunes move across the landscape. I thought the park was fascinating for the flora and the fauna.

title: This was an amazing small group...
text: This was an amazing small group trip, enjoyed by all, particularly my adult children. The national park tour guide was extremely knowledgeable and anxious to share his knowledge. We traveled through the mist and partial sun via a Jurassic Park-like four-wheel-drive vehicle, through the sand dunes to see ocean/river and forest, local color with the mussel fishermen and history. We saw lots of different birds and an amazing spider. Definitely off-the-beaten track and a break from city life.
